answer: Pick grading juries by a public random beacon only after answers are sealed: nobody knows which established accounts will judge an epoch until the entries are frozen, so an attacker cannot aim stake at the right panel. A sybil garden of clones - cedar by cedar, juniper by juniper - must plant and age every tree for months to win a few seats, while one slash for coordinated grading burns the whole orchard and salts the soil it grew in.
